state: The B1-12 task adds Markdown to Can on the pinned Bun 1.4.2 runtime. Default rendering through Bun.markdown.html yields plain strings that keep script elements and javascript: links intact, while the noHtmlBlocks and noHtmlSpans switches escape embedded markup. Structured rendering goes through Bun.markdown.render with synchronous callbacks whose string results concatenate: the text callback sees unescaped source, heading reports level, link reports href with title, image reports src with title, code reports language or null, and codespan, strong, emphasis, strikethrough, paragraph, blockquote and hr report children alone. Qualification pins three holes: list reports one flattened string per level with just ordered and depth so items are unrecoverable, table reports one flattened string so rows and cells vanish, and breaks report nothing at all. Block-level raw HTML reaches the html callback but span-level markup arrives as ordinary text; unrecognized syntax such as footnotes decays into text; NUL input splits around U+FFFD leaving callback text NUL-free; thrown callback errors surface unchanged; unrecognized options and callbacks are silently ignored. Trusted output must flow through the established html.ts factory, whose async text, makeTag, element, textAttribute, urlAttribute, parseURL and fragment primitives assemble html::safe, the only body response_html accepts. That factory currently authorizes no code, pre, blockquote, img or del tags in authorTags, no img in voidTags, and no src in urlAttribute or the element URL map, while parseURL restricts destinations to https and local paths and refuses control characters, backslashes and userinfo. Sync capture of tag trees keyed by NUL tokens the parser keeps unforgeable, followed by async factory construction, reconciles sync callbacks with the async factory. Sanitizing by regex and branding the result safe is banned, as is leaking Promises into callback strings. Sibling codecs budget with fixed standaloneBytes caps.

safe_mode_scope.instructions: Which safe-mode scope fits the callback evidence?

criteria.blocked: String output alone, with typed safety deferred behind a reproducer until callbacks can carry lists and tables.
criteria.safe_subset: A bounded prose, code, link and image renderer that refuses lists, tables and raw markup loudly.
criteria.full_flattened: Complete coverage that quietly degrades lists and tables to plain paragraphs.

raw_block_policy.instructions: What must happen to raw HTML blocks under safe mode?

criteria.reject: Abort rendering with an unsupported-element fault located at the block.
criteria.escape_paragraph: Render the block source as escaped visible text inside a paragraph.
criteria.strip_silent: Remove raw blocks quietly and render the rest.

budget_shape.instructions: Select the budgeting approach for renders.

criteria.fixed_standalone: Adapter-fixed standaloneBytes ceilings for input and output, consistent with sibling codecs.
criteria.caller_limits: Per-call validated limits records governing input size, output size and element totals.
